planets.name: Kepler-10 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-10 with a 45.3-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: Kepler-10 c was found in 2011 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around Kepler-10. Its orbit and size follow Dumusque et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: Kepler-10c
quotes.card: Kepler-10c is an exoplanet orbiting the G-type star Kepler-10, located around 608 light-years away in Draco.
quotes.introduction: Its discovery was announced by the Kepler space telescope team in May 2011, although it had been seen as a planetary candidate since January 2011, when Kepler-10b was discovered.
